fields.description:
**Related:** WAGR-378, WAGR-379

**Summary:** At the Sep 25 call, we agreed to hold a separate session on financial reporting. The Reporting & Dashboards epic has no requirements yet.

**Requirements captured (asks so far)**

* Commission owed, per BA and per manager.
* Redeposit budget use and pacing.
* Deposits inside the Deal's min/max range.
* Bonus trends (Joyce, Aug 13).
* One view of all cash flow (later phase).

**Open decision:** do we mirror data to Snowflake, or does BI read from the API (Sep 11)? The BI-first rule stays: Salesforce does rollups and automation, BI does the visuals.

**Done when:** the session is held, the report list is agreed, and each native report has a story.

**Sources (traceable):**

* Referral and Payouts discovery, 2026-09-25 (next step: financial reporting session) — https://fathom.video/calls/835861150
* Weekly sync, 2026-09-11 (Snowflake vs API) — https://fathom.video/calls/812654105
* Weekly sync, 2026-08-11 (deposits within range) — https://fathom.video/calls/778966539
* Joyce 60-min session, 2026-08-13 (bonus trends) — https://fathom.video/calls/784359049
* Redeposits discovery, 2026-09-16 (budget burn) — https://fathom.video/calls/823343551

---

_Captured 2026-09-25 by Kobi from the WagerTech calls, Slack, Jira and sandbox review (Jul–Sep 2026). Design backlog item: requirements only, not a solution._
